timeline.summary: 2026-04-30: ICRA reaffirmed and assigned [ICRA]A1+ rating for Avenue Supermarts' enhanced commercial paper limit of ₹800 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹17,683.86 Cr (+18.9% YoY), net profit ₹656.42 Cr (+19.2% YoY).
Avenue Supermarts reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹17,205 Cr and PAT of ₹725 Cr, crossing the milestone of 500 stores.
Avenue Supermarts released its FY26 investor presentation detailing network expansion to 500 stores and operational metrics.
Avenue Supermarts filed the annual promoter shareholding encumbrance disclosure for FY26 under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations.
Avenue Supermarts invested ₹150 Cr in subsidiary Avenue E-Commerce via preferential shares, raising its stake to 99.79%.
Gujarat International Finance Tec-City Company Limited imposed a penalty of Rs.55.75 lakhs on Avenue Supermarts Limited on 26th October 2026.
